verdict.rationale:
Phoenix exposes a modular Python SDK and client SDKs for tracing, evaluations, datasets/experiments, and prompt management (docs-9, docs-17, docs-25, docs-44, docs-68), and an MCP endpoint lets external clients query/operate on projects, traces, datasets, experiments, prompts, and annotations (arize-phoenix-docs-58/69). However, human annotations are explicitly described as attached 'directly in the UI' (docs-6/docs-33) with no documented SDK/API equivalent, and no public OpenAPI/REST spec was found (probe-3 shows 404s across candidate API spec paths), leaving some UI-only workflows unconfirmed as API-parity.
missing for 10: documented API/SDK path for human annotation creation, a published OpenAPI/REST spec confirming full UI-API parity, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of complete parity.
